directors.mission: Assess evidence sufficiency, provenance, freshness and missing research without replacing source packets.
Summarize reproducible quantitative evidence, sample limitations and model disagreement.
Compare hunter escalations and desk views while preserving mandate differences.
Consolidate control gates, costs, exposure and explicit risk constraints.
Summarize prior outcomes, calibration evidence and regime-specific lessons without rewriting history.

rules: Directors summarize; they do not mutate underlying packets.
Every director output retains input references.
Dissent and blocking controls remain visible.
No director output is a probability of profit unless backed by an explicit calibration reference.
Missing domain evidence produces DEGRADED rather than invented conclusions.
